1004.title: [TASK] #969 SMOKE-RACE — fix resolve_miscast() missing race param (4 call sites)
1004.body:
## Task

Smoke test run B (krasnolud uczony) revealed that dwarf rdzeń-miscast narrative never fired.
Implementation commit: 5fdd8bbe (develop)

## What was implemented

All 4 `resolve_miscast()` call sites in `combat_service.py` omitted the `race` parameter,
defaulting to `"human"`. Result: `rdzen_miscast` was always `False` for dwarves,
and the rdzeń-flavoured miscast narrative ("Żyła wibruje — krew z uszu, kamień pęka...")
never appeared.

Fix: added `conn.execute("SELECT race FROM characters WHERE id=?", ...)` before each of the
4 call sites, then pass `race=_char_race` to `resolve_miscast()`.

Call sites fixed:
1. `_resolve_effect_spell_in_combat()` ~line 1976
2. `_resolve_aoe_effect_spell_in_combat()` ~line 2105
3. `_resolve_aoe_spell_in_combat()` ~line 2839
4. `_attack_spell_secondary()` ~line 6050

## Files changed

- `backend/app/services/combat_service.py` — 4 resolve_miscast() call sites now pass race

## Backend

`resolve_miscast(sheet, enemy, conn, race="human")` in spell_service.py — existing race-aware
logic now actually receives the correct race from combat_service.

## Numbers Policy

N/A — logic fix, no tunable numbers changed.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Dwarf scholar Nat1 miscast → `rdzen_miscast=True` in response
- [ ] Narrative contains rdzeń flavour text: "Żyła wibruje", "krew z uszu", "pęka"
- [ ] Human Nat1 miscast still uses standard narrative (no rdzeń text)

## Out of scope

- Race-specific miscast thresholds (Nat1+Nat2 for dwarves at L1-2) — works via `is_miscast()` in spell_service, not affected by this fix

1001.title: [TASK] #969 — game-smoke-race: testy grywalności krasnoluda (pytest + Playwright)
1001.body:
## Task
Race playability smoke test suite for dwarf race (#969 R1-R11).
Companion to epic: https://github.com/szmidtpiotr/ai-gm/issues/969
Implementation commit: 3db1589b

## What was implemented

**Skill: `/game-smoke-race`** — 12-checkpoint procedure (2 runs: warrior + scholar):
| # | Checkpoint | Trigger |
|---|---|---|
| CP1 | race='dwarf' in DB | DB query |
| CP2 | CON+2/STR+1/CHA-1/DEX-1 in sheet_json | service test |
| CP3 | Twardy jak kamień: -2 dmg from poison/dark/rdzen | real turn combat |
| CP4 | Kowalskie oko sklep: gold_delta = ceil(base × 0.85) | real turn shop |
| CP5 | Kowalskie oko reperuj: HP+20, gold-20 | repair endpoint |
| CP6 | Wzrok górnika: +3 perception in dungeon | dungeon entry |
| CP7 | Rdzeń starting spells: vein_tremor+rdzen_shield | DB + service |
| CP8 | Miscast Nat1+Nat2 for dwarf, Nat1-only for human | service test |
| CP9 | Race lock: human spells rejected for dwarf | service test |
| CP10 | Narrator: "Rasa postaci: dwarf" in system msg | buildmessages() |
| CP11 | 3 warrior turns without 500 | LIVE HTTP |
| CP12 | 3 scholar turns (rdzeń spells, mana) | LIVE HTTP |

**Automated: pytest (18/20 GREEN)**
- File: `backend/tests/playability/test_race_playability.py`
- CP11+CP12 require `RACE_SMOKE_LIVE=1` (real LLM + live campaign)
- Run: `docker cp ... && docker exec ai-gm-dev-backend-1 pytest tests/playability/test_race_playability.py -v`

**Automated: Playwright (6/6 GREEN)**
- File: `ai_test_agent/playwright/ux/race/race_smoke.spec.js`
- Auto-appears in `/admin/#tools → 🎭 Playwright → group "race"`
- CP2 verifies POST /api/characters accepts race=dwarf; CP3 verifies CON≥12 in response

**Setup script:** `.claude/skills/game-smoke-race/scripts/setup_dwarf_pool.py`
- Creates [TEST] Krasnolud Wojownik + [TEST] Krasnolud Uczony for user_id=1 (idempotent)

## Files changed
- `.claude/skills/game-smoke-race/SKILL.md` — skill procedure, 12 checkpoints
- `.claude/skills/game-smoke-race/scripts/setup_dwarf_pool.py` — dwarf hero setup
- `backend/tests/playability/test_race_playability.py` — pytest suite
- `ai_test_agent/playwright/ux/race/race_smoke.spec.js` — Playwright spec
- `backend/app/api/characters.py` — bug fix: race field missing from standalone CREATE
- `backend/app/services/spell_service.py` — bug fix: race lock stub completed

## Bugs fixed (caught during test authoring)

**Bug A — standalone character creation ignores race** (critical):
`POST /characters` endpoint took `race` from request but stored `human` in DB.
Root cause: archetype was read from `sheet_json`, race was read top-level — but INSERT had no `race` column.
Fix: extract `race` from req, apply `apply_racial_modifiers()`, add to INSERT.

**Bug B — dwarf race lock was stub** (logic incomplete):
`learn_spell()` had `pass` where human-only spell blocking should raise ValueError.
Fix: dwarves now get `ValueError` when attempting to learn any NULL-race_lock spell.

## Backend
- GET `/characters/{id}/spells` — verified working (no changes)
- POST `/characters/{id}/dwarf-repair` — verified accessible (auth required, returns 401 not 404)
- `POST /characters/{id}/xp/spend-spell-learn` — verified exists (no changes)

## Acceptance
- [ ] `python3 setup_dwarf_pool.py` creates warrior_id + scholar_id (JSON output)
- [ ] `pytest tests/playability/test_race_playability.py -v` → 18 passed, 2 skipped
- [ ] Playwright spec `race/race_smoke.spec.js` → 6 passed in `/admin/#tools`
- [ ] Create dwarf via UI wizard → verify race=dwarf in DB and CON≥12
- [ ] Create human via UI wizard → verify race=human, no racial modifiers

## Out of scope
- CP11/CP12 live turn tests: require RACE_SMOKE_LIVE=1 + live LLM campaign setup
- UI wizard navigation test (Playwright MCP): covered by `/game-smoke-race` skill manually

Awaiting visual verification on DEV: https://aigm-dev.studio-colorbox.com/

659.title: [TASK] B11 — AoE multi-target maga (burning_arc/chain_lightning/fireball)
659.body:
## Task
B11 z FAZY B (Balans 3 klas + Czary maga). Implementacja obsługi czarów AoE (`attack_aoe`) w silniku walki — wielocelowe uderzenia dla maga.

## What was implemented
- Nowa gałąź `spell_type=='attack_aoe'` w `resolve_attack` → `_resolve_aoe_spell_in_combat()`
- `aoe=1` (area): 1 rzut d20 vs cel główny; trafienie → ta sama kość damage na WSZYSTKICH żywych wrogach
- `aoe=0` (chain): identycznie ale maks 3 cele (chain_lightning: "skacze przez do 3")
- Loot/XP/death log dla każdego zabitego wroga (reuse istniejącej ścieżki)
- Frontend: wyświetla `aoe_hits[]` — lista trafień AoE po rzucie
- Czary w DB: `burning_arc` (T2, 4m, 1d6, aoe=1) · `chain_lightning` (T4, 5m, 2d6, aoe=0) · `fireball` (T5, 6m, 3d6, aoe=1)

## Files changed
- `backend/app/services/combat_service.py` — `_resolve_aoe_spell_in_combat()` + dispatch w `resolve_attack`
- `frontend/front/js/app.js` — render `aoe_hits[]` w logach walki

## Backend
- Nowa funkcja `_resolve_aoe_spell_in_combat(conn, row, campaign_id, ch_id, sheet, combatants, enemy, target_id, spell_row, raw_d20, out, loot_pool_accum)`
- Dispatch po `spell_type=='attack_aoe'` — po check defense, przed normalnym atakiem
- Mana: odliczona z góry; brak many → blokada jak inne czary
- Nat 1 → miscast (pełna mana stracona)
- Hit → damage każdemu wrogowi (aoe=1: wszyscy; aoe=0: maks 3)
- Śmierć każdego wroga: loot + XP + death log + auto_complete_beats (reuse)

## Numbers Policy (wartości startowe z CZĘŚCI AK — tuning po B13)
- `burning_arc`: tier 2, mana 4, damage_die 1d6, aoe=1 (wszyscy wrogowie)
- `chain_lightning`: tier 4, mana 5, damage_die 2d6, aoe=0 (maks 3 cele)
- `fireball`: tier 5, mana 6, damage_die 3d6, aoe=1 (wszyscy wrogowie)

## Acceptance
- [ ] Mag rzuca `burning_arc` przy 2 wrogach → oba tracą HP
- [ ] Mag rzuca `fireball` przy 3 wrogach → wszyscy 3 tracą HP
- [ ] chain_lightning przy 4 wrogach → maks 3 trafione
- [ ] Mana odliczona po rzucie AoE
- [ ] Przy braku many → blokada z komunikatem
- [ ] Zabity wróg AoE → XP + loot jak normalnie
- [ ] `aoe_hits[]` w odpowiedzi API i wyświetlone w logu walki

## Out of scope
- Ally-target AoE (group_heal) — Faza 2 / Blok 3
- AoE efekty kondycji (blizzard → slowed) — Blok 3
- B13 playtest

Co-implements: #595 (wybór celu) jest już gotowe/review — B11 odblokowany.
